title: Chapter 319: The Mighty One Takes A Strong Action
content:
Chapter 319: The Mighty One Takes A Strong Action

The strength of the nine-star alien race warriors is indeed very strong. They can quickly remove the self-destructing parasites in their bodies, and the consumption of continuous removal is not large.

However, the seven-star soldiers of the Zerg are much more than the eight-star warriors of the alien race, and the seven-star Zerg scorpions are the first to attack, so the egg-laying ability of many seven-star Zerg queens is useless.

The seven-star Zerg queens take turns to attack the nine-star alien race warriors, which buys precious time for the upgrade of the Zerg mother nest and Zerg arms.

In this world, the nine-star warriors can further interfere with the world rules through the exercises and mobilize a large amount of heaven and earth energy.

As long as the nine-star warriors are given the opportunity to attack, they can give the Zerg army a powerful blow.

Facing the attack of the nine-star warriors, the Zerg really has no good way to deal with it when the queen can't easily attack.

Fortunately, the eight-star warriors of various races belonging to the alien race appeared at the same time. This more secure approach for the alien race just gave the Zerg the opportunity to immediately upgrade the Zerg mother nest.

Killing eight-star enemies satisfies the upgrade conditions of the Zerg hive. When the Zerg hive is upgraded to eight-star, all Zerg troops can ignore the restrictions of the world rules and directly upgrade to eight-star strength.

A seven-star Zerg scorpion successfully upgraded to eight-star on the platform built by the transport Zerg host with tentacles.

The eight-star Zerg scorpion, with its status fully restored, instantly launched an extermination attack on the nine-star alien strongman.

The nine-star alien strongman, who was suppressing his anger to remove the self-destructing parasites that kept coming out of his body, was attacked by the rule-level power of the eight-star Zerg scorpion and finally couldn't hold on. He suddenly disappeared, leaving only a ray of white light.

Those spectators from both camps who were able to observe this battle of the strong were shocked by the powerful means of the Zerg.

Everyone finally discovered that the Zerg strongmen who attacked the eight-star and nine-star strongmen of the aliens might be the seven-star troops in the Zerg army, which were rare in number.

The seven-star-strength soldiers can kill the eight-star-strength strongmen with one strike, and now even the nine-star-strength super strongmen have been killed, which has broken the common sense of this world.

Even if the rules of this world are broken, people who can use the world rules to do this have never been seen before, even those extremely powerful foreign evil gods can't do it.

"The Zerg's trump cards are too powerful! They emerge in endlessly!"

"Without the powerful, the soldiers with one star strength lower can kill the enemy with one strike, which is incredible!"

"Yes, it's reasonable for people with low star strength to surround and kill people with high star strength by relying on the advantage of numbers, but it's really terrible to kill them with one strike!"

"Now the nine-star strongmen of the alien race are all dead, and the alien race is expected to explode!"

"With the current strength of the Zerg, we can't intervene!"

"The Zerg may become the first recorded "The first race to obtain the status of a great race through the special quota of the great race status!"

"The Zerg has not yet obtained the status of a great race, but it has such a strong strength. There is really such hope!"

"As long as the Zerg obtains the status of a great race, my native race camp will immediately add a strong ally with at least the strength of a super great race, and our future situation will be greatly improved!"

"It's really exciting!"

"..."

The strong men of the major races watching the battle in the native race camp finally realized at this moment that the strength of their great races is not as good as the current Zerg.

If the Zerg obtains the status of a great race, the strength of the Zerg will be so strong that they dare not imagine it.

From this moment on, no race dares to look down on the Zerg.

...

Wu Qing also knew that the alien race would not give up easily this time, and immediately upgraded two more eight-star Zerg scorpions and two eight-star Zerg queens.

With five eight-star soldiers in charge, Wu Qing's consciousness returned to the main body, and all the upgrade options of the Zerg buildings refreshed by the upgrade of the Zerg mother nest to eight stars were upgraded.

After these upgrades were completed, the strength of the entire Zerg was greatly improved again.

The difference is most easily seen in the combat power of the ordinary Zerg puppies and the three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions, which have never been ranked as stars. Their combat power has been upgraded to the combat power of the top-level one-star troops. In the one-star strength range, there is almost no rival.

Two Zerg puppies hatched with 50 energy resources are enough to rival the strongest one-star troops of other races. The significance of this upgrade is extremely huge.

This means that the Zerg only needs two troops, the Zerg puppies and the three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions, which consume the least resources, to perform most of the combat tasks, and there is no need to send the main Zerg troops to support everywhere.

The strength of all Zerg combat troops fighting on the battlefield has been instantly improved, and their abilities in all aspects have been enhanced.

The alien army opposite the Zerg army felt the most deeply. The attack that could be barely resisted suddenly became unbearable.

The loss of troops of the alien army increased dramatically.

This time, Wu Qing wanted to defeat the alien race as quickly as possible, so the Zerg army did not hold back.

In all directions of the alien race's main city, as long as the Zerg found an opportunity, Zerg puppies and type 3 Zerg poisonous ray scorpions would launch attacks.

Under the overall command of the Queen of Zerg, this huge decisive battle was under the control of the Zerg army.

Wu Qing returned to the battlefield again. The Zerg hive was upgraded to eight stars. There was not much suspense in the decisive battle with the super tribe of the evil god camp, the alien race, and its allies and subordinate races.

This chapter is not over yet, please click on the next page to continue reading!

Now it depends on how much the alien race will struggle.

The alien race probably didn't expect that a force in the tribe would be invested in the public battlefield, hoping to cultivate another branch that could stand alone, but unfortunately encountered the variable of the Zerg.

As an old super tribe in the evil god camp, the alien race has a very deep foundation, but a large number of means are ineffective against the Zerg.

Now there are a lot of means that make other races afraid, but they can't do anything on the Zerg, and they have lost a lot.

Is it willing to fail and suffer heavy losses, or to take another gamble and gamble that the Zerg, which is not a big tribe, cannot compare with the alien race in high-end power.

This decision is very difficult to make. Once the decision is wrong, the loss will be even greater.

The upgraded Zerg army is more aggressive, and there is not much time left for the alien race.

…

A strange-looking figure suddenly appeared above the battlefield, and the energy of the whole battlefield area seemed to be still.

“Defend first!”

Wu Qing finally saw the power of the king in this world, that is, the power of the ten-star powerful people in this world.

He did not let the queen of insects take action immediately, but let the queen of insects use limited power to protect the Zerg army.

The Zerg puppies and three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions around the main city of the alien race, whether they were fighting or not, immediately drilled deep underground.

The Zerg hosts distributed in a certain formation around the main combat force of the Zerg, all burst out with powerful mental power, instantly forming a giant mental power shield.

The powerful people in the alien camp did not take action immediately, but quietly hovered in the air, watching the Zerg army respond quickly and orderly.

"There is a powerful person in the alien camp who is about to take action!"

"Why is that powerful person just watching and not taking action?"

"Are they waiting for the powerful person behind the Zerg to take action?"

"The real goal of the aliens is not the Zerg army. What they want is a higher level of victory. As long as the Zerg has no means to deal with the powerful person, it is very easy for the powerful person to destroy the Zerg army. That's why the powerful person is not in a hurry!"

"The aliens still chose to take a gamble. The powerful person they sent is directly related to the rise and fall of a race. If they lose the gamble, a race, or even a large clan, will decline!"

"This It's better than the decline of the alien race's own strength, it's worth a gamble! "

"The Zerg can't be guessed by common sense at all, I think the Zerg must have a way to deal with it! "

"What if they can deal with it? If the powerful behind the Zerg also takes action and fights here, it will be even more difficult for the Zerg to gain the status of a powerful tribe! "

"Maybe this is why the alien race dares to gamble! "

"Now the decision-making power is on the Zerg side again, let's see how the Zerg will deal with it! "

"..."

Some of the real strong men in the local race camp who came to watch the battle didn't feel strange when they saw the powerful enemy, and they could discuss with each other calmly.

...

According to Wu Qing's request, the Queen of Zerg used the Zerg host to exert power to protect the Zerg army, and did not attack the powerful powerful man with amazing momentum.

The powerful man in the alien race camp with a strange appearance did not wait for the attack of the Zerg powerful man, so he stopped waiting.

With a wave of his hand, he sent down infinite light energy to the main Zerg battle force. This was a much more powerful attack than the enhanced version of the large battlefield magic star fall, and the abilities below the Great Power were simply unable to contend with it.

The spiritual power shield covering the main Zerg battle force was immediately activated, blocking the continuous light energy attack and protecting the Zerg army inside.

This giant spiritual power shield has the characteristics of the Queen's power, and the power of the Great Power cannot break it for a while.

Seeing this, the Great Power pointed out again, and a point of extremely sharp and indestructible power shot at the spiritual power shield, stimulating the invisible spiritual power shield to emit light.

This great power attack that broke through the surface with a point still failed to break the spiritual power shield that protected the main Zerg battle force.

The Queen of the Zerg successfully blocked the attack of the Great Power with the critical spiritual power, and did not cause the disgust of the world rules.

This is the result of the Queen of the Zerg's research on her own power control, which is perfectly stuck in the power limit that this world can bear.
